intro: Step through the Winter sequence together. Required steps must happen; Offering and Wager are optional — answer when you reach each one.

children.label: 1. Card Unlock
children.body: All players may return locked Spread cards to hand.

children.label: 2. Offering to the Age (optional)
children.body: Discard cards meeting the threshold to gain a boon from the Cosmic Age.

children.label: 3. Fateful Wager (optional)
children.body: Wager Spread cards against the Fates for a chance at powerful rewards.

children.label: 4. Enforce Card Limits
children.body: Discard down to hand and Spread limits before the next Age.

children.label: 5. Reset deck & pass Key
children.body: Shuffle the Common Deck. Pass the Agekeeper Key clockwise.
